research.ants.barbed-needles.name: Barbed Needles
research.ants.barbed-needles.description: Needler hits lower the target's armor by 1 for 5 seconds, up to 3.
research.ants.carapace-1.name: Carapace I
research.ants.carapace-1.description: Ant troops gain 1 armor (level I; levels add up).
research.ants.carapace-2.name: Carapace II
research.ants.carapace-2.description: Ant troops gain 1 armor (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Nest.
research.ants.carapace-3.name: Carapace III
research.ants.carapace-3.description: Ant troops gain 1 armor (level III; levels add up). Requires the Queen's Chamber.
research.ants.hardened-wings.name: Hardened Wings
research.ants.hardened-wings.description: Alates gain 100 health and fly 20% faster.
research.ants.living-wall.name: Living Wall
research.ants.living-wall.description: Majors gain 2 armor, and their Guard cuts the damage small ants take by 25% instead of 15%.
research.ants.mandibles-1.name: Mandibles I
research.ants.mandibles-1.description: Raiders, Majors and Bullet Ants deal 10% more attack damage (level I; levels add up).
research.ants.mandibles-2.name: Mandibles II
research.ants.mandibles-2.description: Raiders, Majors and Bullet Ants deal 10% more attack damage (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Nest.
research.ants.mandibles-3.name: Mandibles III
research.ants.mandibles-3.description: Raiders, Majors and Bullet Ants deal 10% more attack damage (level III; levels add up). Requires the Queen's Chamber.
research.ants.needle-hardening-1.name: Needle Hardening I
research.ants.needle-hardening-1.descrip: Needlers, Honeypots, Alates and Acid Spires deal 10% more attack damage (level I; levels add up).
research.ants.needle-hardening-2.name: Needle Hardening II
research.ants.needle-hardening-2.descrip: Needlers, Honeypots, Alates and Acid Spires deal 10% more attack damage (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Nest.
research.ants.needle-hardening-3.name: Needle Hardening III
research.ants.needle-hardening-3.descrip: Needlers, Honeypots, Alates and Acid Spires deal 10% more attack damage (level III; levels add up). Requires the Queen's Chamber.
research.ants.pheromone-mastery.name: Pheromone Mastery
research.ants.pheromone-mastery.descript: Heralds learn Panic and Gardeners learn Spore Cloud.
research.ants.sticky-nectar.name: Sticky Nectar
research.ants.sticky-nectar.description: Honeypot globs splash wider (3.4 units) and leave the survivors 30% slower for a while.
research.ants.venom-glands.name: Venom Glands
research.ants.venom-glands.description: Agony lingers for 10 seconds instead of 6. Requires the Queen's Chamber.
research.ants.volatile-sacs.name: Volatile Sacs
research.ants.volatile-sacs.description: Burster bursts deal 150 damage instead of 100 and no longer hurt allies.
research.ants.wider-tunnels-1.name: Wider Tunnels I
research.ants.wider-tunnels-1.descriptio: Every mound lets 50% more ants into the tunnels each second (level I; levels add up).
research.ants.wider-tunnels-2.name: Wider Tunnels II
research.ants.wider-tunnels-2.descriptio: Every mound lets 50% more ants into the tunnels each second (level II; levels add up). Requires the Queen's Chamber.
research.beetles.afterburners.name: Afterburners
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-1.name: Bolt Calibre I
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-1.descript: Bolters, Steamwings, Hornwatch gunners and Bolt Turrets deal 12% more attack damage (level I; levels add up).
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-2.name: Bolt Calibre II
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-2.descript: Bolters, Steamwings, Hornwatch gunners and Bolt Turrets deal 12% more attack damage (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Bastion.
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-3.name: Bolt Calibre III
research.beetles.bolt-calibre-3.descript: Bolters, Steamwings, Hornwatch gunners and Bolt Turrets deal 12% more attack damage (level III; levels add up). Requires an Elder Bastion.
research.beetles.drum-magazines.name: Drum Magazines
research.beetles.fragmentation-shells.de: Bombard and Juggernaut shells burst wider: blast radius grows to 3.5 units and they slow survivors by 25% for 2 seconds.
research.beetles.heavy-pistons.name: Heavy Pistons
research.beetles.heavy-pistons.descripti: Breachers can charge every 5 seconds instead of 10. Requires a Great Bastion.
research.beetles.interlocking-shields.de: Locked shields interlock: Lock Shields gives 7 armor instead of 4 and cuts piercing damage by 45% instead of 30%.
research.beetles.plating-1.name: Plating I
research.beetles.plating-1.description: Beetle troops and machines gain 2 armor (level I; levels add up).
research.beetles.plating-2.name: Plating II
research.beetles.plating-2.description: Beetle troops and machines gain 2 armor (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Bastion.
research.beetles.plating-3.name: Plating III
research.beetles.plating-3.description: Beetle troops and machines gain 2 armor (level III; levels add up). Requires an Elder Bastion.
research.beetles.pressure-mains.name: Pressure Mains
research.beetles.pressure-mains.descript: Raises the pressure in the colony’s mains: the substance network reaches 8 cells further around the Bastion, the Substance Wells and every Brood Den. Requires a Great Bastion.
research.beetles.riveted-hulls-1.name: Riveted Hulls I
research.beetles.riveted-hulls-1.descrip: Machines gain health: Bombards +100, Steamwings +80, the Juggernaut +450.
research.beetles.riveted-hulls-2.name: Riveted Hulls II
research.beetles.riveted-hulls-2.descrip: Machines gain the same again: Bombards +100, Steamwings +80, the Juggernaut +450. Requires an Elder Bastion.
research.beetles.specialist-training-ade: Arcwrights learn Static Field, Menders Field Repair and Wardens Bulwark Pulse.
research.beetles.specialist-training-mas: Every specialist ability reaches its second rank: stronger Arc Surge and Static Field, Mend and Field Repair, a cheaper Barrier Field and a stronger Bulwark Pulse. Requires an Elder Bastion.
research.beetles.weapon-edges-1.name: Weapon Edges I
research.beetles.weapon-edges-1.descript: Shieldbearers and Breachers deal 12% more attack damage (level I; levels add up).
research.beetles.weapon-edges-2.name: Weapon Edges II
research.beetles.weapon-edges-2.descript: Shieldbearers and Breachers deal 12% more attack damage (level II; levels add up). Requires a Great Bastion.
research.beetles.weapon-edges-3.name: Weapon Edges III
research.beetles.weapon-edges-3.descript: Shieldbearers and Breachers deal 12% more attack damage (level III; levels add up). Requires an Elder Bastion.
